intro: Investigate Echo Ridge is an early military assignment issued by Marshal McBride in Northshire Valley. Tasked with probing the Echo Ridge Mine to the north, recruits are sent to cull the encroaching kobold workers and determine the true scope of the infestation threatening the abbey's mineral wealth.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, my scouts tell me that the kobold infestation is larger than we had thought. A group of kobold workers has camped near the Echo Ridge Mine to the north.
Go to the mine and remove them. We know there are at least 10. Kill them, see if there are more, then report back to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you been to the mines? Are you ready to report?

clips.title: Completion
paras: I don't like hearing of all these kobolds in our mine. No good can come of this. Here, take this as payment, and when you're ready, speak to me again. I would like you to go back to the mines one more time...

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
